# Street props

Models by Kenney, CC0. Original license files are retained in each pack folder.

- Car Kit 3.1: https://kenney.nl/assets/car-kit
- City Kit (Roads) 2.2: https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-roads

Downloaded from the author's public OpenGameArt releases because the primary download server returned HTTP 403:

- https://opengameart.org/content/car-kit
- https://opengameart.org/content/city-kit-roads

Only selected FBX models and their color palettes are included. Source models remain unchanged. The project creates normalized, merged prefabs with subdued vertex colors and one shared instanced material. The small litter bin is authored in the project. Regenerate with Tools > City > Build Street Prop Prefabs.
